name: France – puissance souscrite (TURPE, kVA)
assumed: The subscribed kVA (6, 9, 12 …) is the household's own and asked, and the Linky meter cuts at it with no tolerance assumed; the HP/HC hours are the meter's own band and Tempo's colours arrive as day-type events (D1 §5.6), so the rule holds no capacity charge.
